en.s: A weather warning published on October 24 highlighted the risk of heavy rainfall and landslips in the Nilgiris, Kodaikanal and Manjolai Hills over the coming days.

en.t: Dalit Teen Takes His Own Life In Tamil Nadu After Alleged Caste Taunts Over Beef
en.s: A Class 11 Dalit student died by suicide in Coimbatore after alleged caste-based harassment. Police arrested a teacher and booked three others.

en.t: Protest in Coimbatore Over Student’s Suicide After Beef-Eating Disclosure
en.s: According to allegations, fellow students had been avoiding Akilan at school, while a teacher allegedly subjected him to mental harassment by questioning him about eating beef

en.t: Protesters demand arrest of teacher and headmaster after student suicide in Coimbatore
en.s: Relatives of 16-year-old Akilan protested in Coimbatore, seeking the arrest of a teacher and headmaster over alleged caste-based discrimination.

en.t: TN: Protest in Coimbatore over student's suicide; protesters demand arrest of teacher, headmaster
en.s: Relatives of a 16-year-old student who allegedly died by suicide after facing caste-based discrimination and mental harassment staged a protest outside the Coimbatore District Collectorate on Friday, demanding the arrest of the teacher and headmaster concerned and the cancellation of the school's…

en.t: Class 11 TN student dies by suicide after classmates taunt him over eating beef
en.s: A Class XI student died by suicide after alleged caste-based bullying at his Coimbatore school. The teacher's arrest has intensified scrutiny of the institution's response to his complaints.

en.t: Coimbatore Student's Tragic Suicide Linked To Caste And Beef Bullying
en.s: A Class XI student in Coimbatore tragically died by suicide following alleged caste-based harassment and bullying related to his Scheduled Caste identity and beef consumption.

en.t: Contractor fined for illegal felling of 80 trees in Coimbatore
en.s: COIMBATORE: Coimbatore corporation has fined a private contractor ₹1.27 lakh for illegally felling trees from the Sengulam lake here.

en.t: Coimbatore Dalit student’s death: Two classmates arrested, parents continue sit-in demanding headmaster’s arrest
en.s: Akilan, a Class 11 student at the government-aided school on Avinashi Road, was found dead at his home in Peelamedu on Wednesday.

en.t: Five youths arrested with ganja, narcotic pills in Coimbatore
en.s: Coimbatore police arrested five youths in Peelamedu, seizing 2.5kg ganja, 2,830 narcotic pills and 150 sleeping pills; probe ongoing.
